evidence.rationale: No numerical forecast bound is asserted. Actual trading results differ by nearly 0.99 trillion VND between two periods; economic forecast precision depends on market activity rather than a 1-VND EPS rounding branch.

The paired revaluation net is only 3.231414097 billion VND, whereas source-read realized trading net is in trillions. Removing unrealized marks does not normalize the market-cycle contribution; no arbitrary grid width is used.

Margin loans increase from 25.606519152893 to 43.162734820966 trillion VND. Forecast precision depends on collateral/credit conditions, liquidity and funding spreads. These are economic dependencies; no numerical stress loss, regulatory breach or forced financing event is invented.
